limitations: All nine traits are FinnGen-derived, so participant overlap is substantial; cross-trait LDSC intercepts are retained in the full RDS.
The genetic analysis provides disease-level context and does not validate a tissue-specific transcriptomic pathway.
BMI, T2D and hypertension are correlated cardiometabolic traits; myopia and migraine are descriptive non-cardiometabolic comparators, not assumed-null negative controls.
